reasoning_steps: Identify the positions of the snails on the garden plot.
Note that the snail crawls at a speed of 1 m/h and the fast snail at 2 m/h.
Calculate the relative speed of the snails by subtracting the slow snail's speed from the fast snail's speed.
Determine the distance covered by the fast snail in the same amount of time as the slow snail.
Identify the point where the snails meet for the first time.
